title: SIGIR 2027
institution: 50th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR 2027)
about: SIGIR 2027, the 50th ACM SIGIR conference on information retrieval, runs 18-24 July 2027 in San Jose, California. Full-paper abstracts are due 14 January 2027 and full papers 21 January 2027 (AoE); notification is 5 April 2027.
requirements: Full paper abstract submission January 14, 2027; full paper submission January 21, 2027 (AoE)
A full paper cannot be submitted without a previously submitted abstract
Full author list must be specified at abstract submission time; no authorship changes afterwards
All authors need OpenReview accounts before the abstract deadline

upskill.name: Retrieval Engineering & Query Optimization
why: "Field: Information retrieval" → "Design effective retrieval pipelines using query rewriting, expansion, decomposition, filtering, routing, and other techniques that improve the quality of information retrieved for a user request."
"Research and Development in Information Retrieval" → "Diagnose retrieval failures systematically and improve document relevance, ranking, recall, and coverage using evaluation evidence."
